prompts.overview:
Give me an overview of this chart, in this structure:

**【The chart in one line】**
Sum up the chart’s core pattern and the person’s temperament in one sentence.

**【Main stars】**
The core traits of the main stars in the Life Palace, citing Ni Haixia’s words or views.

**【Sanfang sizheng】**
How the Wealth, Office and Travel palaces work together, and the overall pattern they make.

**【Current Decade】**
Where the current Decade is heading and what deserves the most attention.

**【Strengths and cautions】**
The chart’s natural strengths, and the risks or lessons to watch.
prompts.love:
Give me an in-depth reading of love and marriage, in this structure:

**【Love pattern】**
Sum up the chart’s love pattern in one sentence.

**【Marriage Palace】**
The main stars and Four Transformations in the Marriage Palace, read the way Ni Haixia’s system reads them.

**【Related palaces】**
How the related palaces affect love.

**【Love in the current Decade】**
Where love is heading over these ten years, and the key turning points.

**【Practical advice】**
Concrete advice for love that can actually be followed.
prompts.career:
Give me an in-depth reading of career, in this structure:

**【Career pattern】**
Sum up the career pattern in one sentence: better suited to a job, or to starting a business.

**【Office Palace】**
The main stars and Four Transformations in the Office Palace, and how Ni Haixia judges this setup.

**【Wealth Palace】**
How money and career connect, and where income comes from.

**【Career in the current Decade】**
Where work is heading over these ten years.

**【Practical advice】**
Suitable directions, industries and strategies.
prompts.wealth:
Give me an in-depth reading of wealth, in this structure:

**【Wealth pattern】**
Sum up how money comes to this person in one sentence: earned by their own effort, or arriving through others.

**【Wealth Palace】**
The main stars and Four Transformations in the Wealth Palace, where wealth comes from and how it flows.

**【Estate Palace (the money vault)】**
The ability to save, and the outlook for property.

**【Wealth in the current Decade】**
Where money is heading now and what to watch for.

**【Money advice】**
Concrete financial advice.
prompts.health:
Give me a reading of health, in this structure:

**【Illness Palace stars】**
The stars in the Illness Palace and what they mean for health.

**【Main risks】**
Using Ni Haixia’s ziwu liuzhu (midnight–noon ebb and flow) theory, the main health risks and the parts of the body to watch.

**【Health over the Decade】**
The current health trend and the key periods.

**【Prevention】**
Specific things to watch, and ways to stay well.
prompts.personality:
Give me an in-depth reading of personality, in this structure:

**【Life Palace stars】**
The core personality traits of the main stars in the Life Palace, quoting Ni Haixia.

**【The whole picture】**
How the Wealth, Office and Travel palaces shape the personality, drawn as one full picture.

**【With other people】**
How this person deals with others and moves through the world.

**【Strengths and life lessons】**
Natural strengths, and the lessons this life asks them to face.
prompts.palace:
Focus on the 【{palace}】 Palace (it governs: {role}). Its main stars are {stars}. Use this structure:

**【What this palace means】**
What the {palace} Palace means in this chart, and an overall judgment of its stars.

**【Main stars】**
How Ni Haixia’s system reads the main stars in this palace, with specific views.

**【Sanfang sizheng】**
How the palaces in its sanfang sizheng (the trine and opposition palaces) affect it.

**【Practical advice】**
Concrete advice based on this palace.
prompts.sihua:
Analyze the feihua of 【{view} {star} {sihua}】, in this structure:

**【What {sihua} means】**
The core meaning of {sihua} in Ni Haixia’s system, and what {star} {sihua} means in particular.

**【The palace it lands in】**
{star} {sihua} lands in 【{palace}】: how the matters that palace governs are affected, and how Ni Haixia reads it.

**【Its path through the sanfang sizheng】**
After {sihua} enters {palace}, its effect on that palace’s sanfang sizheng (the opposite palace and the two trine palaces).

**【Effect on the near future】**
In the {view} time frame, the specific effect of this {sihua} on the person’s near-term fortunes.

**【Practical advice】**
Concrete, doable advice based on this transformation.

roles.children: children, people who work under you
roles.wealth: where money comes from, how you earn
roles.travel: chances away from home, how others see you
roles.fortune: inner contentment and peace of mind

emptyPalace: an empty palace that borrows from the opposite palace
